info.name: Bill Pay Endpoints API
info.description:
The Bill Pay API allows you to create and manage bill payments.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

urlencoded.description: (Required) The ID of the account bill pay merchant.

An optional reference number for the client.
A unique key to prevent duplicate transactions.
